newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates largely higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates largely higher.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were largely higher on Friday, reflecting the anticipated increase in domestic interest rates, dealers said.
Only the one and two-week rates were unchanged.
"This is the view of the people that interest rates will go up little by little. Interest rates had bottomed out already," a foreign bank dealer said.

The Central Bank had wanted rates to rise after it increased its overnight borrowing rate to 10 from 9.9 percent on Thursday, a move seen to attract more dollar inflows and mop up liquidity, traders said.
